|translation='''Title:''' Death Star.

'''Card text:''' X = the parsec number of the current location. Deploy at parsec 0. Hyperspeed = 1. Not affected by Revolution. If put out at the start of the game, the Light Side goes first.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names 革命 for Revolution.
|notes='''Death Star (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Death Star|Death Star]]. [[Decipher]] released it in [[Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy]] on 10 January 2001. The ordinary Japanese expansion printing is [[Death Star (Japanese)]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R32 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.<ref name="checklist">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R32.
